verdict.rationale: Terraform's native format is the Terraform-format codebase and state, so an existing codebase works without conversion. Configuration files are versioned HCL (terraform-docs-1). State maps real-world resources to configuration and can be stored in remote backends and edited with `terraform state` (terraform-docs-20, terraform-docs-33, terraform-docs-6). Resources not yet in state can be brought in with import and import blocks (terraform-docs-5, terraform-docs-50, terraform-comm-18). Community reports confirm codebases carry across versions with only minor HCL changes (terraform-comm-1), and that backend state is adopted by re-running `terraform init` (terraform-comm-16). missing for 10: first-party docs on migrating state between backends or Terraform versions, explicit compatibility guarantees for older codebases and state files, and hands-on accounts of a full migration.
